title: State of Rajasthan v. G. Chawla

content.caseIdentity: State of Rajasthan v. G. Chawla, AIR 1959 SC 544
content.holding: Upheld State regulation of loudspeakers under public health (Entry 6, List II); encroachment on telegraphs and broadcasting (Entry 31, List I) held incidental.
content.relevance: Public health regulation vs Union communications entry.
